instruction: Add a new PUBLIC function `pub fn humanize_duration(secs: u64) -> String` near the other text helpers (truncate/progress). Format a duration in seconds as a compact human-readable string. Algorithm: days=secs/86400, hours=(secs%86400)/3600, minutes=(secs%3600)/60, seconds=secs%60; push only NON-ZERO components in order d,h,m,s each as `{n}{unit}`; join with single spaces; if secs==0 return "0s". Required exact outputs: 0=>"0s", 45=>"45s", 60=>"1m", 90=>"1m 30s", 3600=>"1h", 3661=>"1h 1m 1s", 86400=>"1d", 90061=>"1d 1h 1m 1s". Only ADD the function; do not modify anything else.

observed_baseline._history: Local agentic react was UNBLOCKED 2026-06-07 (commit b6964195 — translate Anthropic content-blocks → Ollama format). Before that, three stacked confounds made all react data invalid: (1) --model ignored on the tools path → every run was gemma4-12b (fixed c73a04d8); (2) provider-walk fell to Tenstorrent cloud, so multi-turn 'passes' weren't the local model; (3) ollama 400'd on multi-turn array content → local loop couldn't run at all. Post-b6964195, qwen react went 0/5 (fast-400) → 3/5 (real multi-turn, 34-136s) — first valid local agentic data. all three react rates below are now VALID (n=5, post b6964195). RESULT — react is strongly model-dependent, ranking exactly as agentic-capability predicts: devstral-small-2:24b 5/5 (agentic-tuned coder) > qwen2.5-coder:14b 3/5 (coder) > gemma3:12b 0/5 (general). fast-arm data was always valid.

agentic-tuned coder — BEST driver, 100%. Fits 15.2GB VRAM. Recommend as the local do-loop model.
